candidate_sentences.text: During the financial year ended 31 December 2025, AS Tallinna Sadam Group achieved consolidated revenue of EUR 118,687 thousand, representing a slight decrease of 0.8% or EUR 901 thousand compared to EUR 119,587 thousand in 2024.
Despite the minor drop in revenue, the Group improved its profitability indicators.
Adjusted EBITDA increased by 6.4% or EUR 3,375 thousand to EUR 56,510 thousand, compared to EUR 53,134 thousand in 2024, pushing the adjusted EBITDA margin up to 47.6% from 44.4%.
Profit for the period grew by 17.3% or EUR 3,310 thousand to EUR 22,463 thousand, compared to EUR 19,153 thousand in 2024.
Total assets at period-end stood at EUR 622,063 thousand, down 1.2% from EUR 629,861 thousand, while total equity rose by 0.9% to EUR 380,877 thousand from EUR 377,613 thousand.
Net debt decreased significantly by 15.5% to EUR 141,708 thousand compared to EUR 167,622 thousand at the end of 2024.
Capital investments were reduced by 14.4% to EUR 33,245 thousand from EUR 38,831 thousand.
